name: network_escalation
description: Customer with persistent network issues escalates aggressively. Agent handles professionally but cannot resolve.
transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Jio. My name is Amit. How may I assist you?
Customer: Amit, this is the sixth time I'm calling about the same network issue. My calls keep dropping in my area and nobody is doing anything about it.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear about the ongoing issue, sir. May I have your mobile number to look into this?
Customer: 9988776655. Customer ID JIOP-33445.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Patel. I can see the previous tickets. I understand this has been very frustrating for you.
Customer: Frustrating is an understatement. I run a business and I'm losing clients because of your network. I want to speak to a supervisor right now.
Agent: I completely understand, Mr. Patel. Your concern is valid. Let me connect you to our senior resolution team who can provide a more concrete timeline.
Customer: I don't want timelines. I want it fixed. If this isn't resolved by tomorrow, I'm taking this to consumer court and switching to Airtel. I've already talked to a lawyer.
Agent: Sir, I want to assure you that we take this very seriously. I'm creating a priority escalation ticket right now. The ticket number is ESC-2024-7890. Our network engineering team will investigate your area within 24 hours.
Customer: That's not my problem. Your company should have fixed this weeks ago. I want compensation for the business I've lost.
Agent: I understand your concern about compensation, Mr. Patel. I'm noting that request in the escalation. The senior team will discuss compensation options with you when they call back within 24 hours. Can I confirm your callback number?
Customer: Yes, call me on the same number. And this better be the last time I have to call about this.
Agent: Absolutely, Mr. Patel. I apologize for the extended inconvenience. Your escalation ticket ESC-2024-7890 is now with the highest priority team. Thank you for your patience.
